description: This Java class 'DefaultDeletionConfig' implements configuration for deletion operations, including parameters like enabled status, deletion age, run interval, and first interval hour. It reads its configuration from a 'Config' object and provides validation and standard object methods.

classes.name: DefaultDeletionConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing DeletionConfig interface, encapsulating deletion-related configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getDeletionAge
methods.description: Returns the duration after which deletion occurs.

methods.name: getRunInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval between deletion runs.

methods.name: getFirstIntervalHour
methods.description: Returns the hour of the day when the first deletion run should occur.
